launches.title: Adapted - AI Physical Therapy for Athletes
launches.tagline: Prehab, recovery, and mobility - personalized to your body and goals
launches.body:
**TLDR:** Adapted is an AI physical therapist for athletes - prehab, recovery, and mobility protocols personalized to you. Try [Adapted for iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/adapted-prehab-recovery/id6756030925)!

### Background

I’ve sprained my left ankle over 20+ times. During Army training, my ankle almost gave out during a ruck. That's when I realized being fit but fragile is still a liability.

### Problem

Fixing my ankle was more painful than the injury itself. PT meant hours off work, generic exercises, and $200 a visit out of pocket. And even then, it only treated the injury, not the underlying weakness.

### Meet Adapted

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99406&key=user_uploads/1032232/d89e036e-c103-4368-8a83-e5ab1a53a7f7)

[Adapted](https://www.adapted.app/) is an AI physical therapist for athletes. Tell it your injury history, your sport, your training goals, and it builds a program tailored to you. Whether you’re rehabbing an injury, bulletproofing your body to train harder, or improving mobility and flexibility, Adapted adapts as you do.

### About Us

I’m Albert - amateur boxer (165 lbs), Army Reserves infantryman, and former software engineer at Uber. I’ve shipped consumer health apps before and scaled them to hundreds of daily active users.

### Try Adapted Out

* [Download Adapted (iOS App Store)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/adapted-prehab-recovery/id6756030925)
* Email us at [team@adapted.app](mailto:team@adapted.app)
* Support our [Product Hunt launch](https://www.producthunt.com/products/adapted-health)
* Join our Subreddit ([r/adapted](https://www.reddit.com/r/adapted/)) if you any have questions
